nodes.name: CrypNuevo Methodology — Full Extraction + Verdict
nodes.summary: Full 4-layer weekly bias + liquidity zone system extracted and corrected from earlier wick-only simplification. 1) Weekly bias from HTF structure/funding/OI, 2) Liquidity zone mapping on Hyperliquid order book, 3) Entry AFTER sweep + rejection (not before), 4) Multi-TP exit. Rejection filter reduces false signals from 20+/week to ~2.5/week. Cross-asset backtest: SOL WR 43.2%, PF 1.52 (+9.75R, 44 signals, under 100 minimum). BTC (28.0% WR, 0.78 PF) and ETH (30.4% WR, 0.66 PF) fail gate. OHLCV-only version is pale imitation — real edge requires Hyperliquid order book depth, funding rate extremes, and OI divergence. Nuevo bias function crude (SMA slope → 95% neutral). Paths: knowledge/strategies/crypnuevo-full-weekly-bias-system.md, scripts/playbook_nuevo_weekly.py, scripts/nuevo_game.py.
